prompt: Read data.json (a list of people). Write adults.json containing only the entries with age >= 18, sorted by name ascending, same object shape, as a JSON array.
check: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('adults.json')); assert [p['name'] for p in d]==['Ada','Cy'], d; assert all(p['age']>=18 for p in d)"
